subgoal_prompt: Precise COLOR DESIGN EDIT of the reference approved abstract sci-fi robot application schematic. Preserve exactly the composition, all objects, route geometry, obstacle, cube, arrowheads, labels and English title spelling. Same landscape aspect ratio. Recolor to harmonize with an elegant light academic website with white rounded cards, pale #f4f6fb background, navy #232946 typography and blue #1565c0 links. Replace the dark navy image background with a very pale mist blue/off-white #eef4fa, soft restrained atmospheric shading, no dark vignette. Title and START/GOAL labels dark navy #173653, crisp modern sans serif, no neon glow on text. Robot: simplified translucent mid cobalt blue forms with deep blue edges and gentle teal highlights; preserve schematic abstract style, do not become a realistic metal robot. Successful route: strong medium teal #009da8 with a subtle light cyan inner highlight, high contrast against light backdrop, no washed-out white lines. Barrier: translucent pale lavender, violet edges #8672c8, clearly lighter and secondary to the robot/route. Subgoal node and grasped cube: restrained rich warm amber #f2a51a with subtle glow, SUBGOAL label amber-brown #ac6c00 so readable. Target: translucent pale blue slab with cobalt and teal rim, recess visibly distinct. Remove overblown halos and visual noise; polished sophisticated futuristic EDUCATIONAL SCHEMATIC, easy to read, clean and airy with tiny grounding shadows. This is a palette refinement, not redesign. NO new objects, no technical modules, no extra wording, no logos/watermark.
